title: Our Environment
summary: Grade 10: trophic levels and the 10% law, biological magnification, the ozone layer, and managing the waste we produce.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Energy flows through ecosystems while harmful substances can build up, so human choices about chemicals and waste affect every level.

conceptual: Why is the top of a food chain most at risk from pesticides?
How do our choices change waste?
debatable: Should single-use plastics be completely banned?
